ann.title: Grade Review for ECO3121
ann.body:
To improve the efficiency of grade review process and guarantee fairness to all students, the detail for the meeting of grade review will have two parts.
If students only want to know exam grade for each question (we have totally 4 questions), students do not need to register and just come to TxD 604 this Friday (22nd) from 1pm to 5pm.
If students want to check the midterm exam paper, students are required to register the following link: [course link]
To be noticed, during the exam paper review,
1.    all questions will be reconsidered and regraded;
2.    students are not allowed to take mobile phone, backpack /handbag, pencil or papers into the review venue.
3.    students are not allowed to take photo /or video recording /or copy the exam questions /or answers with pens and papers.
4.    students could only review their scores and grade; they were not allowed to know the grade of the other students.
If you still have problems, please contact me. Mail me with evidence of any necessary time conflict to ask for other possible grade review.

ann.title: Midterm exam arrangement
ann.body:
To ensure a smooth midterm exam experience, I am writing to share the confirmed arrangements for the exam and adjustments to the class schedule before midterm. Please read the following information carefully.
Midterm Exam Schedule:
Date: November 9, 2024
Time: 4:00 PM - 6:00 PM
Venue: Liwen Hall
Additional Information:
Content Covered: The midterm will cover everything we have learned in class before the exam, excluding the instrumental variable.
Question Type: Exam questions will be based on lectures and problem sets, formatted as short-answer questions. Please read the attached one past mid-term exam sample for       reference in BB.
ECO3121_Midterm Exam_Sample.pdf
Exam Type: This is a closed-book exam. You can bring only your student card, drinking water, and stationery. No any other materials or calculators are permitted.
Seat Plan: The seat plan will be released soon.
Cheating Sheet: An “official” cheating sheet will be uploaded to Blackboard before the midterm, and printed copies will be provided during the exam. Please note that only this     official sheet is allowed; it includes some complex formulas but does not cover the basic knowledge you are expected to understand.
Class Schedule Adjustment:
            1. Classes on November 5 and November 7 will be canceled to help you prepare for the exam. The theme of the class on October 31 will be a midterm review.
            2. Our tutorial on November 6 and November 7 will talk about problem set 2.
If you have any other questions, please do not hesitate to contact me. Thanks for your cooperation!
